post.summary: Run a benchmark suite. No project; every cell is a throwaway.
Start a bench without holding the request open: cells run as ordinary runs and the result appears in the list when done.

get.summary: The budget every run starts with. It was invisible and immutable, so a run that hit the ceiling failed with a number nobody had chosen.
Per-mode defaults: rounds, the duckling line-up, and the per-turn model-call cap. All lived only in the scripts and the config.
SSE event stream. Accepts ?token= because EventSource cannot set headers.
Engine liveness. No auth: a client must reach it before reading the token file.
Read an artifact and any pending proposal

delete.summary: Discard a pending proposal. A rejected one stays on disk by design (05 §1.1); this is the person's explicit act of letting it go.

put.summary: Correct what a report says. A bug could be moved, triaged and promoted but never edited.

post.summary: Promote a bug to a task

get.summary: The configured gate beside the one detection finds today

post.summary: Adopt the detected gate. Never automatic: a gate decides what a verdict means.
Run the gate now and report what happened. On demand: a gate can be a whole test suite.
